old_problem: NVNetPerf/DOCA versions, suite manifest, DUT/peer/port/direction/NUMA topology, traffic matrix and per-case throughput/latency/loss/error limits are absent. Inventory-only, grep/head output and unverified ssh cannot prove suite coverage or performance.
disposition_reason: The Master clearly requires completion of the applicable NVNetPerf suite and comparison with project networking criteria. Per the user's parameterization rule and ED-05/14/15, missing topology, package versions, traffic parameters and performance thresholds are Project Configuration Requirements; they block execution/PASS but not review resolution. The rewritten case keeps Ethernet and InfiniBand/RDMA modes explicitly separated and demands raw results for every applicable case/direction.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2105, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2106 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00473-V005 / b7e991a6b8b5831e was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Pin DOCA SDK, NVNetPerf, NIC/SmartNIC firmware, driver and exact suite manifest/configuration; version-dependent case membership is archived, not inferred.
Bind DUT and peer hosts, interfaces/ports, directions, NUMA/CPU/GPU affinity, link mode/speed, MTU, flow control, routing and RDMA attributes before load.
Ethernet and InfiniBand/RDMA cases retain independent configuration, metrics and acceptance; one transport cannot satisfy the other.
Every applicable case/direction records raw throughput, latency/tail, loss, variance and completion plus synchronized NIC/fabric/host counters and errors.
No PASS without signed per-case thresholds and completeness policy; a high aggregate cannot hide a failed direction or omitted case.
Use authenticated host-verified sessions and isolated/approved traffic domain; reject sshpass, host-key bypass, head/grep-only evidence and shared-network surprise load.
Stop on unexpected traffic/congestion, excessive loss/errors, link/fabric fault, host instability or thermal/power anomaly; preserve first result and do not automatically rerun.
No DOCA/NVNetPerf, interface change, network traffic load, recovery, retry or DUT/peer action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized topology-bound DOCA NVNetPerf full-suite qualification
test_case.purpose: Run every applicable NVNetPerf case on the intended HGX/SmartNIC topology and prove each Ethernet and/or InfiniBand/RDMA direction meets its signed throughput, latency, loss, variance, error and completion criteria without destabilizing the fabric or hosts.
required_package: Pinned compatible DOCA SDK, NVNetPerf, driver/NIC firmware, license and full suite manifest/configuration
Separate Ethernet and InfiniBand/RDMA link, MTU, flow-control/routing and transport configuration
Message size, queues, concurrency, duration/repetition plus per-case performance/error thresholds
Secure authenticated access, isolated/approved traffic domain, monitoring, aborts and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until the suite, topology and quantitative Project Configuration are signed. Securely capture complete inventory/link/counter/host baselines; after point approval execute the pinned NVNetPerf manifest case-by-case in every required direction and transport, retaining exact command/config, raw output, timing and synchronized counters. Compare each result only with its supplied threshold and verify manifest completeness. Stop on first safety/fabric/host anomaly; never load an unapproved network, filter evidence or automatically retry a failure.
test_case.expected_result: Every required manifest entry and direction completes on the mapped endpoints/configuration and independently meets its signed throughput, latency/tail, loss, variance, counter/error and completion limits; Ethernet and IB/RDMA results remain distinct, no unexpected traffic or platform/fabric health issue occurs, and post-load state matches the approved baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without pinned suite/topology/traffic parameters and quantitative per-case criteria. Thereafter PASS requires complete manifest coverage and all individual results within limits with clean counters/health. FAIL on any threshold breach, omitted/wrong direction or transport, unexpected loss/error/congestion or recovery failure. Missing package/peer/spec/access/evidence is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until endpoints, transport separation, suite/load matrix, thresholds, isolation, aborts and recovery are approved.
Verify host identity and secret-safe access; never target an unapproved shared or production path.
Monitor link/fabric/host/thermal/power continuously and preserve full raw evidence/counters.
Stop without retry on unexpected traffic, excessive loss/error, link/fabric fault, host instability or safety excursion.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approvals and DOCA/NVNetPerf/driver/firmware identities plus manifest checksum
Signed per-case traffic parameters and throughput/latency/loss/variance/error criteria
Full raw command/config/output/timestamps for every applicable case and direction
Synchronized NIC/SmartNIC/fabric/host/error/thermal/power counters and manifest completeness report
Threshold comparison, first-fault/recovery or clean post-load baseline, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unexpected network scope, congestion/loss/error, link/fabric degradation, host instability or thermal/power excursion, stop traffic using the approved path and preserve all artifacts. Do not rerun or alter parameters. Restore only authorized interfaces/routes/transport state and quarantine affected endpoints/fabric until health is proven.

source_conflict.reason: Source consistently requires NVNetPerf suite completion against project criteria; missing configuration and thresholds are parameterizable project inputs.

blocked.reason: The review-layer method and safety/PASS structure are complete; execution later remains BLOCKED until packages, peers, topology and criteria are supplied.
